how_to_apply: Applications go by post or to the official email ID [email protected] and must reach PRSC by 17/11/2026. PRSC is not responsible for delays, and late applications will be summarily rejected.
Download the prescribed application form, with the details of the certificates and supporting documents needed, from www.prsc.punjab.gov.in.

Pay the non-refundable fee for the post: Rs.2000/- for Principal Project Associate and Geospatial Assistant; Rs.1500/- for Research Scientist, Research Associate and Research Fellow; Rs.1000/- for Jr. Research Fellow and Project Assistant.

Pay online to State Bank of India, PAU Branch, Ludhiana, Account No. 32430207442, IFSC Code SBIN0001482. Alternatively, deposit a Demand Draft in favour of Director, Punjab Remote Sensing Centre payable at Ludhiana in the office of Punjab Remote Sensing Centre, PAU Campus Ludhiana-141004.
If you pay online, write the Receipt/UTR/Acknowledgement Number in the application form and attach proof of the fee payment.
Attach one set of attested copies of degrees and certificates and one passport size photograph to the filled form.
Send the application by post or to [email protected] so that it reaches PRSC by 17/11/2026.
To apply for more than one post, fill a separate application form with a separate non-refundable fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: PRSC has advertised 26 posts across seven positions. The notice calls the number of positions provisional. PRSC may increase or decrease this number. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals need to apply. The last date for receipt of applications (17/11/2026) is the cut-off date for all purposes, including age, qualification and experience. Each post has its own essential qualification, set out below with the alternatives ("OR") kept as the notice prints them. Essential Qualifications: Doctorate Degree in Soil Science & Agriculture Chemistry or equivalent OR (a) First Class Bachelor Degree in Agriculture (4 Year Course) and (b) First Class Postgraduate degree in Remote Sensing and GIS/ Geoinformatics/ Geospatial Technology (or equivalent) with specialisation in soil science OR (a) First Class Bachelor Degree in Agriculture (4 Year Course) and (b) First Class Postgraduate degree in Soil Science and Agriculture Chemistry along with good knowledge of Remote Sensing and GIS as evident from publications/thesis/technical reports/experience AND Four Years' experience in RS/GIS applications for PhD degree holders and Eight years' experience in RS/GIS applications for Master degree holders Desirable: proficiency in GIS and image processing software; good knowledge of programming in Google Earth Engine/Python/R/MATLAB; experience in interpretation of data and writing reports/papers in peer reviewed journals. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Every post carries a consolidated monthly amount plus HRA, as shown in the vacancy table. The notice does not state the HRA amount or rate. The posts are offered purely on a contractual basis for a period of six months, or for the period specified against the post. This period is likely to be extended based on the candidate's satisfactory performance review and the requirements of the Project Scheme or Centre. The notice also states that the engagement is for the duration of the project, which may be 6 months to 3 years, and may be extended as per project or Centre requirement. The positions are temporary and for a specific duration. Selected candidates may be posted at any location as required, including Ludhiana, Chandigarh, SAS Nagar (Mohali) and anywhere in Punjab.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PRSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications go by post or to the official email ID [email protected] and must reach PRSC by 17/11/2026. PRSC is not responsible for delays, and late applications will be summarily rejected. Download the prescribed application form, with the details of the certificates and supporting documents needed, from www.prsc.punjab.gov.in . Pay the non-refundable fee for the post: Rs.2000/- for Principal Project Associate and Geospatial Assistant; Rs.1500/- for Research Scientist, Research Associate and Research Fellow; Rs.1000/- for Jr. Research Fellow and Project Assistant. Pay online to State Bank of India, PAU Branch, Ludhiana, Account No. 32430207442, IFSC Code SBIN0001482. Alternatively, deposit a Demand Draft in favour of Director, Punjab Remote Sensing Centre payable at Ludhiana in the office of Punjab Remote Sensing Centre, PAU Campus Ludhiana-141004. If you pay online, write the Receipt/UTR/Acknowledgement Number in the application form and attach proof of the fee payment. Attach one set of attested copies of degrees and certificates and one passport size photograph to the filled form. Send the application by post or to [email protected] so that it reaches PRSC by 17/11/2026. To apply for more than one post, fill a separate application form with a separate non-refundable fee for each post. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 provisional vacancies, including 10 for Geospatial Assistant, 6 for Project Assistant and 4 for Jr. Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach PRSC by post or email by 17/11/2026. Late applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the PRSC Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a Bachelor Degree in Science/Engineering/Agriculture/Geography OR a three-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology, AND five years' experience in the field of Remote Sensing and GIS.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for PRSC posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay plus HRA ranges from Rs 27,000 (Jr. Research Fellow and Project Assistant) to Rs 60,000 (Geospatial Assistant). The Principal Project Associate post carries Rs49,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The pay for every post is printed as a consolidated amount "+ HRA". The notice does not state the HRA amount.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs.2000/- for Principal Project Associate and Geospatial Assistant, Rs.1500/- for Research Scientist, Research Associate and Research Fellow, and Rs.1000/- for Jr. Research Fellow and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for PRSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.prsc.punjab.gov.in, attach attested certificates, a photograph and fee proof, and send it by post or to [email protected] by 17/11/2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee shortlists applicants for a Written/Skill Test. Candidates who secure the minimum qualifying marks are then interviewed.

faq.question: Q9. Is the PRSC job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contractual and temporary, initially for six months, likely to be extended. The project engagement may run from 6 months to 3 years.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. You must submit a separate application form with a separate non-refundable fee for each post.
